author: Gabe_JP
quote: An incredible step back from the previous entries. I was hoping this game would move the needle in every aspect and, in some cases, it does. The world is incredible, what you can and can't do in it... is not. In fact, the beauty of the game world make this whole situation even more frustrating. The worst part? As soon as the online drops, everyone will forget what Rockstar did to what once was the greatest "morality doesn't matter" franchises on the planet.
